findings.current: I had suspected it even while looking at him, but the old man standing before me was the former S-rank Hunter of the previous generation known as Uncle Chuck.
findings.defect: “Former S-rank Hunter” implies that Chuck no longer holds that rank, while the source identifies him as an S-rank Hunter from the previous generation.
findings.rationale: 전 세대 modifies his generation, not his current Hunter rank.
findings.replacement: I’d suspected as much just from looking at him, but the old man before me really was a previous-generation S-rank Hunter known as Uncle Chuck.
findings.source: 눈앞의 노인은 일명 엉클 척(Uncle Chuck)이라 불리던 전 세대의 S급 헌터였다.

findings.current: I answered in a baffled voice.
findings.defect: “Baffled” conveys confusion, whereas 떨떠름한 describes an uncomfortable, reluctant, or dissatisfied tone.
findings.rationale: The narrator is awkwardly trying to explain away his ignorance, not expressing bewilderment.

findings.current: Every time Chuck Hagel took a deep drag from his cigar, clouds of acrid smoke billowed toward the ceiling. Alarms sounded, and red lights began flashing.
findings.defect: The alarm onomatopoeia is omitted, losing an explicit comic and auditory beat.
findings.rationale: 위잉! 위이잉! is a separate, intentionally emphasized sound effect immediately preceding the spoken fire warning.
findings.replacement:
Every time Chuck Hagel puffed on his cigar, acrid smoke billowed up to the ceiling, setting off an alarm as red lights flashed.

Wee-oo! Wee-oo!
findings.source:
척 헤이글이 시가를 뻑뻑 피워 댈 때마다 뿜어져 나온 매캐한 연기가 천장에 닿자, 경고음과 함께 붉은빛이 깜빡거린다.

위잉! 위이잉!

findings.current: “When the hell is this fucking hallway going to get wider? Every time I see it, I want to smash it to pieces.”
findings.defect: The draft renders one profanity twice, unnecessarily intensifying Chuck’s vulgarity.
findings.rationale: 빌어먹을 supplies one strong modifier for the hallway; the source does not also contain an equivalent of “the hell.”
findings.replacement: “When is this damn hallway going to get wider? Every time I see it, I want to smash it to pieces.”
findings.source: 「이 빌어먹을 복도는 도대체 언제 넓어지는 거야? 볼 때마다 박살을 내 버리고 싶군.」

findings.current: “Hey, Gaze. Chuck’s touchy because of the terrorist problem these days. He’s a good guy at heart, so try to understand him.”
findings.defect: “Gaze” incorrectly treats 게이즈 as a name or English noun rather than the transliterated address “guys.”
findings.rationale: 게이즈 represents English “guys” and addresses the people accompanying Johnson.
findings.replacement: “Hey, guys. Chuck’s touchy because of the terrorist problem these days. He’s a good guy at heart, so try to understand him.”
findings.source: 「헤이. 게이즈. 요즘 척이 테러리스트 문제 때문에 예민해서 그래. 본성은 착한 친구니까 이해해 줘.」

findings.current: Of course they were. Anyone who irritated Chuck Hagel even a little would have their life ruined.
findings.defect: “Ruined” softens the explicit statement that the offender’s life would end and weakens the repeated 끝내주다/끝날 dark punchline.
findings.rationale: 인생이 끝날 means the person’s life would end, continuing the preceding wording for comic menace rather than merely predicting reputational or career damage.
findings.replacement: Of course they were. Anyone who got even slightly on Chuck Hagel’s nerves would have their life ended.
findings.source: 당연히 끝내주겠지. 척 헤이글의 심기에 조금이라도 거슬렸다가는 그 사람의 인생이 끝날 테니까.

findings.current: “And now his grandson and a young hero have taken up the baton. All of you… welcome to Building Five.”
findings.rationale: 외손자 specifically means a daughter’s son, matching the established relationship between Cheon Taemin and Team Leader Choi.
findings.replacement: “And now his maternal grandson and a young hero have taken up the baton. Both of you… welcome to Building Five.”
findings.source: 「그리고 이제 그 외손자와 젊은 영웅이 바통을 이어받았군. 자네들 모두…… 5동에 온 것을 환영하네.」

findings.current: I nodded slightly and silently mouthed the name of the middle-aged man approaching us with measured steps.
findings.defect: The draft changes an internal thought into visible lip movement.
findings.rationale: 마음속으로 explicitly locates the utterance in Taekyung’s mind; he does not physically mouth the name.
findings.replacement: I gave a small nod. As the middle-aged man approached with measured steps, I murmured his name in my head.
findings.source: 작게 고개를 끄덕인 나는 절제된 걸음으로 다가오는 중년인의 이름을 마음속으로 중얼거렸다.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it alters one Hunter’s status, loses a kinship distinction, changes an internal thought into a physical action, weakens a death threat, and contains several localized register and wording errors.
